title: Spicy Revithia Chickpea Stew
description: A hearty, flavorful stew inspired by Greek cuisine, perfect for a cold evening. Made with chickpeas, revithia, and a kick of spice.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add chili flakes and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add revithia, chickpeas, tomato paste, and lemon juice.
Stir to combine, then add 4 cups of water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with lemon wedges and chopped fresh herbs if desired.
